concerns.text: Task T049 allows sampling only 30 participants if full streaming is infeasible, which weakens FR-001 that requires preprocessing *all* valid participants. This constitutes a retroactive narrowing of the functional requirement.

No task explicitly validates the success criterion SC-003 (partial correlation r ≥ 0.3). The specification demands this threshold, but the task list lacks a verification step that checks the correlation value against the required minimum.

Task T033 generates FDR information but does not include a verification step asserting that the corrected q‑value stays below the required 0.05 threshold (SC-004). This omission leaves the success criterion unverified.

While T018b creates a QC summary JSON, the specification (SC-001) requires that the *rate* of participant exclusion be measured against the 10 % volume‑threshold. No task computes or records this exclusion rate metric.

SC-002 requires reporting that the hierarchical Bayesian model converges for ≥ 90 % of N_valid participants. Although T025b aggregates convergence logs, it does not compute or assert the ≥ 90 % convergence rate.
Tasks T001‑T003 implement a demo pipeline that is not linked to any functional requirement in the spec, representing unnecessary scope creep and potential drift from the defined project boundaries.
The constitution (Principle I) mandates that random seeds be pinned for reproducibility, yet no task mentions seeding or a reproducibility‑verification script.
Constitution Principle II requires a step to run the Reference‑Validator Agent on all citations; the task list does not include such a verification step.
